newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSI signs up Hamersley for ore supply.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSI signs up Hamersley for ore supply.

text.p: Australian United Steel Industry Ltd (AUSI) said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with RTZ-CRA unit Hamersley Iron Pty Ltd for the supply of 7.5 million tonnes a year of iron fines for its proposed US$1.5 billion iron pellet project in Western Australia.
"AUSI chairman Sir Russel Madigan signed the agreement with Hamerslery last night," AUSI managing director Patrick Patterson told an industry conference.
Patterson told Reuters later that the contract would extend for 10 years and was worth A$1 billion.
Patterson said earlier on Wednesday that AUSI was negotiating with Hamersley for the iron ore supply.
AUSI plans to begin production in 2000 and reach full production of four million tonnes a year of direct reduced iron from a new project on the northwest coast of Western Australia a year later.
Patterson said the project was subject to two native title land claims, but he did not expect the actions to delay the project's timetable.
